description: This file defines the AuthService class which manages authentication operations such as user registration, login, and token generation using Flask-JWT-Extended in a Flask web application.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Handles authentication-related operations such as user registration and login, including token issuance.

methods.name: User register(self, email: str, full_name: str, password: str, roles: _Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, full name, password, and optional roles. Creates roles if they do not exist.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str,User] login(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and password, returning access and refresh tokens along with the user object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] tokens_from_user(self, user: User)
methods.description: Generates access and refresh tokens for an existing user.

ctags.name: _Optional
ctags.pattern: /^from typing import Optional, List, Tuple, Optional as _Optional$/

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^    def login(self, email: str, password: str) -> Tuple[str, str, User]:$/

ctags.name: register
ctags.pattern: /^    def register(self, email: str, full_name: str, password: str, roles: _Optional[List[str]] = /
ctags.signature: (self, email: str, full_name: str, password: str, roles: _Optional[List[str]] = None)

ctags.name: tokens_from_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def tokens_from_user(self, user: User) -> Tuple[str, str]:$/
